introduction: Montana’s Elderly Homeowner/Renter Credit is refundable property-tax relief claimed through the income-tax system.
description: Montana’s Elderly Homeowner/Renter Credit is refundable property-tax relief claimed through the income-tax system.

sections.who: Applicants must be62+ at year-end, meet Montana and home-occupancy duration rules and pass the total-household-income test.
sections.get: The amount depends on household income, rent and property tax. Renters and homeowners can qualify.
sections.docs:
• Income for all household members.
  • Rent or property-tax records.
  • Age and occupancy information.
sections.apply:
1. Check eligibility

    Use Revenue’s credit page for the claim year.

  2. Choose filing method

    Use Form2 and Schedule2EC; eligible people without another filing requirement can use TAP’s credit route.

  3. Submit and save

    Retain calculations and the filing confirmation.
sections.after: A person without a normal income-tax filing requirement still needs to claim the credit.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Elderly credit eligibility; TAP filing options. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: The rule uses total household income.
Eligible people can use the designated credit filing route.
